sources.covers: sensor (Sony IMX392LQR-C), shutter, resolution, sensor format and effective diagonal, pixel size, frame rates, interface, synchronisation, power, lens mounts, size, mass

note: A board-level / small-housing colour USB 3.0 machine-vision camera. Sold without a lens, so no FOV, f-number or focus is stated: the imager has no FOV and the library uses its labelled default until the user enters the chosen lens (or a calibration). Resolution 1936 x 1216 full, 1920 x 1200 default. Frame rate 67 fps with default settings, 164 fps with default settings and the Device Link Throughput Limit disabled. Pixel formats are on a separate page (not read): format null. Power "~2.3 W (typical) @ 5 VDC". Mass "<15 g" for the S-mount and CS-mount models (a bound, so mass_g is null; bare board <5 g). size_mm is the S-/CS-mount housing, 20 x 29 x 29 mm (L x W x H), L along the optical axis. Effective sensor diagonal 7.9 mm, as stated.
interface: USB 3.0 (SuperSpeed, nominal max. 5 Gbit/s); USB3 Vision

sync.what: General specifications, Synchronization: "Via hardware trigger, Via software trigger, Via free run"; 4 GPIO lines.
